correctness.rationale: Disjointness of two-support codewords follows from shared-one Hamming distance two and d_pair≤4. For disjoint P,Q, d_pair=8-e(C_n[P∪Q]), so each union has at most one cycle edge. Incidence counting excludes n=7,8 with three supports and n=9 with four. Circulant simple connected 4-regular graphs provide Euler tours at all even n≥10; inserting a common zero does not lower pair distance, providing odd n. At full even support each position receives one word label twice and no adjacent same-label positions, and pair-distance forces no repeated graph edge. Independent exhaustive enumeration of all 945 perfect matchings of 10 coordinate positions, using direct cyclic pair-distance rather than the submitted Euler recurrence, found exactly 22 admissible matchings and three dihedral orbits of sizes 2,10,10. The source independent K5 tour checker was read and gives 528 tours from a fixed start, agreeing 5*528/5!=22.
residual_risks: Length-10 finite enumeration is exhaustive for 945 perfect matchings but not proof of the all-n formula, which rests separately on the graph argument.
